name: TCHP (DOCEtaxel / CARBOplatin / Trastuzumab / Pertuzumab)
histology: invasive breast carcinoma (histology-agnostic; includes invasive ductal carcinoma (IDC) and invasive lobular carcinoma (ILC))

biomarkers.note: HER2-directed dual-antibody regimen: requires HER2-positive disease (IHC 3+ or ISH-amplified). Adds pertuzumab to the TCH backbone. HR (ER/PR) status is tested to guide endocrine therapy, not the HER2 backbone. Anthracycline-free (no doxorubicin). Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Invasive Breast Cancer, Preoperative/Adjuvant Therapy (BINV-M).

lineOfTherapy: adjuvant or neoadjuvant HER2-directed chemotherapy plus dual HER2 antibody blockade for early-stage HER2-positive breast cancer; not line-scoped

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: adequate LVEF; evaluate LVEF before and during HER2-targeted therapy
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v6.2026, BINV-M 1 of 10, For Those Receiving HER2-Targeted Therapy

drugs.name: DOCEtaxel
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 7 of 10. DOCEtaxel 75 mg/m2 IV day 1, every 21 days for 6 cycles. Tall-man per ISMP.

drugs.name: CARBOplatin
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 7 of 10. CARBOplatin AUC 6 IV day 1 (target AUC, not mg/m2), every 21 days for 6 cycles. Tall-man per ISMP.

drugs.name: Trastuzumab (loading dose)
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 7 of 10. Trastuzumab 8 mg/kg IV day 1 (loading dose).

drugs.name: Trastuzumab (maintenance)
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 7 of 10. Trastuzumab 6 mg/kg IV on day 1 (maintenance), every 21 days to complete 1 year of therapy.

drugs.name: Pertuzumab (loading dose)
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 7 of 10. Pertuzumab 840 mg IV day 1 (flat loading dose).

drugs.name: Pertuzumab (maintenance)
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 7 of 10. Pertuzumab 420 mg IV day 1 (flat maintenance dose), every 21 days to complete 1 year of therapy.

premedications.name: DOCEtaxel premedication
premedications.notes: corticosteroid premedication per docetaxel labeling; confirm schedule against institutional order set.

supportiveCare: G-CSF / myeloid growth factor support: all cycles given with myeloid growth factor support per Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M dosing footnote n.
Antiemetics: DOCEtaxel plus CARBOplatin combination; prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier (verify exact NCCN antiemesis tier).
Cardiac: evaluate LVEF before and during trastuzumab/pertuzumab (LVEF prior to initiation and every 3 months per FDA label / BINV-M 1 of 10).

monitoring: LVEF at baseline and periodically during dual HER2 blockade (every 3 months per FDA label / BINV-M 1 of 10)

doseModificationRules.condition: significant decline in LVEF or symptomatic heart failure
doseModificationRules.text: Hold HER2 antibodies and obtain clinical review per LVEF monitoring guidance (BINV-M 1 of 10). Physician decides on continuation.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: lines 22102 to 22107 (HER2/ERBB2-amplified breast cancer: trastuzumab + pertuzumab + chemo among listed options); lines 31926 to 31934 (pertuzumab with trastuzumab and docetaxel first-line HER2-positive breast cancer, CLEOPATRA)

guideline.locator: Dosing: Preoperative/Adjuvant Therapy Regimens, HER2-Positive, TCHP (DOCEtaxel/CARBOplatin + Trastuzumab + Pertuzumab), BINV-M 7 of 10; setting/eligibility BINV-M 3 of 10 and BINV-M 1 of 10

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for the breast HER2-directed regimen TCHP. Serves subtype #4 (HER2-positive), histology-agnostic across invasive ductal (#1) and invasive lobular (#2) carcinoma. DeVita 12th ed. names the trastuzumab-plus-pertuzumab-plus-chemo framework (lines 22102 to 22107) and the CLEOPATRA basis for pertuzumab (lines 31926 to 31934) but does not tabulate per-drug doses; therefore every numeric dose is sourced to Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Invasive Breast Cancer v6.2026, BINV-M 7 of 10. DOCEtaxel 75 mg/m2 and CARBOplatin AUC 6 day 1, every 21 days for 6 cycles; trastuzumab 8 mg/kg loading then 6 mg/kg every 21 days; pertuzumab 840 mg flat loading then 420 mg flat every 21 days, to complete 1 year. Trastuzumab loading versus maintenance (mg/kg) and pertuzumab loading versus maintenance (flat mg) are recorded exactly as the source states. ISMP tall-man applied (DOCEtaxel, CARBOplatin). No field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
